name: Wormmon
main_effect: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 green or blue card with 2 or more colors and 1 Tamer card with [Ken Ichijoji] in its name among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
source_effect: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
